topic: Sensor status data for inventory setup
summary_markdown:
The discussion concerns updating the request regarding sensor statuses. This information is intended for a dedicated import/export page located near inventory, used primarily by internal teams when setting up or linking boxes to a facility. While there is potential future consideration to display this data on client cards, it has not been formally planned.

The urgency of the request was noted, with one participant suggesting that the need stems from a recently developed feature requiring immediate utilization.
decisions: The sensor status query will be updated.
action_items: [me] to update the sensor status data request.
